messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident P-78912 triggered: HTTP 5xx rate spike on inference-gateway-east1 (alerts: 10m error_rate > 5%)
pagerduty-bot: Pager sent to rotation: @sam (oncall) -> escalation in 8m if unacked
sam (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking. first glance: 502/503s from gateway -> upstream 502s to runtime pods
maya (sre): copying runbook snippets for 5xx spike: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/5xx-inference 
maya (sre): command I usually run: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide`
sam (oncall): running that now...
sam (oncall): ```
NAME                                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
gateway-6b7f8d9c6f-zzj4p                  1/1     Running   0          12d   10.240.1.45  ip-10-0-2-15
gateway-6b7f8d9c6f-ptl2x                  1/1     Running   0          12d   10.240.2.18  ip-10-0-3-22
gateway-6b7f8d9c6f-fail2                  0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  5  3h   10.240.3.9   ip-10-0-4-10
```
sam (oncall): one gateway pod in CrashLoopBackOff, logs show upstream 502s and connection reset: `error: upstream read failed: connection reset by peer`
toni (eng-runtime): likely kv-cache eviction or model-worker OOM. Checking runtime metrics: spike in latency and many `kvcache.miss` events
alex (sre-senior): can we tail runtime logs for one of the model-worker pods? `kubectl -n inference logs model-worker-0 -c runtime --tail 200`
sam (oncall): pulling logs now, seeing repeated: `RuntimeError: out of memory while allocating attention buffer` and `quantize_worker: failed to mmap`
jordan (support): CS alerting: two enterprise customers reported 502s via support channel, high priority accounts. They see errors across EU region.
maya (sre): impact assessment: error rate bubbled up across east1 and eu1 edges. Suggest immediate mitigation: fail traffic from east1 gateway -> fallback region eu-fallback, and drain problematic gateway pod.
sam (oncall): initiating graceful drain of gateway pod: `kubectl -n inference cordon ip-10-0-4-10 && kubectl -n inference drain gateway-6b7f8d9c6f-fail2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`
incident-bot: Drain initiated by sam (oncall).
toni (eng-runtime): while that happens, enable model-variant fallback for high QPS routes to a smaller quantized model to reduce memory pressure. Patch snippet in console: `route.override_model=rt-small-q8` for routes /v1/infer/highQPS
sam (oncall): applying route override now.
(8s later)
sam (oncall): override applied, re-routing ~15% of traffic to fallback model to test degradation impact
maya (sre): scaling suggestion: scale model-worker replicas from 4 -> 8 temporarily. `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=8`
toni (eng-runtime): scaling up infra-backed GPU pool as well via autoscaler API, request submitted: `POST /internal/autoscaler?pool=model-gpu&delta=4`
alex (sre-senior): I'm taking over the pager in 5m if you're still handling, @sam. Also start a short-term alert silence for noisy 5xx so we don't autopage during remediation: PD silence 30m (admins only).
sam (oncall): noted, will hand off if still active. Created PD silence id S-45321 (30m)
jordan (support): pinging affected customers: ETA 20m for mitigation to settle, offering status update and asking for error logs, telling them we are prioritizing their traffic.
(2m later)
sam (oncall): gateway pod drained and replaced, new pod in Running. `gateway-6b7f8d9c6f-repl2 1/1 Running`
sam (oncall): model-worker replicas scaled; metric shows kvcache miss rate dropping, 5xx rate from gateway trending down from 7.2% -> 1.4%
maya (sre): good; keep watch for rate returning. saving graphs: https://internal.redwood/graphs/incident/1733337777
toni (eng-runtime): confirming runtime heap pressure reduced after route override. will stick with fallback config for 30m and then do gradual rollback after monitoring.
alex (sre-senior): taking final check before handoff: can we confirm no new PD pages?
incident-bot: No active pages in P-78912. Incident status: mitigation in progress, monitoring.
sam (oncall): handing off to @maya for next 30m watch. I'm available if it re-escalates.
maya (sre): ack. will monitor dashboards and check for regression. collecting logs for postmortem: creating ticket INC-5890 and attaching snapshots
jordan (support): will follow up with customers and escalate internally for SLA notes.
alex (sre-senior): nice coordination. follow-ups: jot down exact commands used, timeline, and any config toggles. probable root cause: model-worker memory pressure after quantized model rollout earlier today.
maya (sre): assigning owners: eng-runtime to investigate model memory regression (toni), infra to validate autoscaler tweak (alex), support to confirm impacted customers (jordan).
sam (oncall): closing active PD page for now, leaving incident thread open for postmortem notes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-78912 resolved by ack and silence. Resolution note: traffic reroute + scaling reduced 5xx rate below threshold.
maya (sre): creating follow-up doc and scheduling 1h blameless postmortem meeting. thanks all. :thumbsup:
